---
name: 'Documentation Standards'
description: 'Writing conventions for documentation'
applyTo: 'docs/**/*.md'
---

# Documentation Standards

- Present tense ("The system processes..." not "will process...")
- Active voice ("Run the command" not "The command should be run")
- Second person ("You can configure..." not "Users can configure...")
- Include code examples for any technical instruction
- Headings to organize; maximum 3 levels deep
- Link to related docs rather than duplicating content
- "Prerequisites" section when steps require setup
